text:
### Modification Process  
**Online Modification:**
1. Customer logs into online banking
2. Selects standing order to modify
3. Changes desired field(s)
4. Confirms modification
5. Receives confirmation  
**Branch/Phone Modification:**
1. Customer calls or visits branch
2. Provides standing order ID and current details
3. Specifies changes requested
4. Staff member updates system
5. Sends confirmation to customer  
**Note:** Full changes (amount, payee, frequency) may require cancellation of old SO and creation of new SO

raw_entities.name: Standing Order Modification Process
raw_entities.description: The end-to-end procedure for amending existing standing orders via online banking or through branch and phone channels. It includes paths for simple field updates and full changes requiring replacement.

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: The bank customer who initiates the modification of a standing order either through self-service online banking or by contacting the bank via phone or branch visit.

raw_entities.name: Branch Staff
raw_entities.description: The bank employee responsible for updating the system records when a customer requests a standing order modification via phone or in-person visit.

raw_entities.name: Online Banking Login
raw_entities.description: The initial step of the online modification path where the customer authenticates into their online banking account.

raw_entities.name: Standing Order Selection
raw_entities.description: The step where the customer identifies and selects the specific standing order they wish to modify from their account list.

raw_entities.name: Field Modification
raw_entities.description: The action where the customer enters the new values for the desired fields of the standing order.

raw_entities.name: Modification Confirmation
raw_entities.description: The final customer action to commit the changes to the standing order.

raw_entities.name: Online Confirmation Receipt
raw_entities.description: The system-generated notification sent to the customer confirming the online modification was successful.

raw_entities.name: Channel Contact Initiation
raw_entities.description: The initial step for non-digital modifications where the customer contacts the bank via phone or visits a physical branch.

raw_entities.name: Standing Order Identification
raw_entities.description: The step where the customer provides the standing order ID and current details to the staff member for verification.
context: Provides standing order ID and current details

raw_entities.name: Change Specification
raw_entities.description: The step where the customer explicitly states the changes they wish to apply to the standing order.

raw_entities.name: System Record Update
raw_entities.description: The action performed by the staff member to update the standing order details within the bank's internal systems.

raw_entities.name: Staff-Initiated Confirmation
raw_entities.description: The final step where the staff member ensures a confirmation of the change is sent to the customer.

raw_entities.name: Modification Scope Check
raw_entities.description: A decision point to determine if the requested changes are simple field updates or 'full changes' (amount, payee, frequency). Full changes trigger a different workflow: cancellation of the old SO and creation of a new one.
context: Full changes (amount, payee, frequency) may require cancellation of old SO and creation of new SO
